taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-13, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note – Station T-13 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
The interpreted 5-layer geoelectric profile exhibits a continuous increase in resistivity with depth:
- **Layer 1** (0.00–1.08 m): 1,340.2 Ω·m (unsaturated surface soil)
- **Layer 2** (1.08–2.46 m): 2,148.3 Ω·m
- **Layer 3** (2.46–3.72 m): 5,322.7 Ω·m
- **Layer 4** (3.72–4.05 m): 18,475.7 Ω·m
- **Layer 5** (>4.05 m): 19,320.3 Ω·m (dense, resistive bedrock basement)

**Curve Type & Hydrogeological Remarks:**
Because resistivities consistently increase across all adjacent layer triplets ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3 < r_4 < r_5$), the 5-layer sequence corresponds to an AAA curve type (standardly designated as A-type). The file classification of A-type is accurate. The high bedrock resistivities indicate poor shallow aquifer potential.

{"curve_type_stated": "A", "label_issue_flagged": false}
